title: Placement Stick
description: a special stick for block placement in air
body:
Placement Stick Datapack

This datapack adds a special stick that allows players to place blocks in mid-air, even without support beneath them.

  • Craftable via a custom recipe
  • To activate its power, players must hold a glass block in their off-hand
  • Works in both survival and creative modes
  • Perfect for building sky bridge or floating structures

Installation Instructions

  1. Download the datapack ZIP file
  2. Open Minecraft and select the world you want to install it in
  3. Click “Edit” → “Open World Folder” → open the datapacks folder
  4. Place the downloaded ZIP file inside the datapacks folder
  5. Launch the world and type /reload (if cheats are enabled) or press F3 + T to reload resources
  6. Craft the Placement Stick using the custom recipe

Compatible with Minecraft 1.20+. No mods required.
